entities.name: Eliterate Colony
entities.description: Vodalian merfolk enclave in a deep trench founded by outcast artists escaping Empress Galina.

entities.name: Empress Galina
entities.description: Tyrannical Vodalian empress who died in Yawgmoth's deathcloud.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Took the form of a deathcloud that killed most of Vodalia.

entities.name: Bo Levar
entities.description: Planeswalker who sacrificed his life to stop the cloud reaching the commune.

entities.name: Emperor Omen
entities.description: Moderate captain who ruled New Vodalia; in reality the Eliterate actor Destry.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: Vodalian realm devastated by the deathcloud.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion near whose end Yawgmoth became a deathcloud.

events.summary: Yawgmoth becomes a deathcloud that kills most of Vodalia, including Galina.
events.quote: Galina was one of the many casualties, ending her thousand-year reign

events.summary: Bo Levar sacrifices his life to stop the cloud reaching the Eliterate commune.
events.quote: sacrificed his life to prevent the cloud from reaching the Eliterate commune

events.summary: Destry as Emperor Omen rebuilds New Vodalia and stages his death with illusion magic.
events.quote: this was a staged death using illusory magic

relations.note: Emperor Omen was really the Eliterate actor Destry
relations.quote: a moderate captain of the Imperial army
